caption: The drawing depicts a "chest box" shown in two views rendered in black lines on a yellowed, beige background. In the top view, the chest has a rectangular top measuring 23 7/8 inches in length; it is supported by four turned columns at the corners. The front face contains symmetrical decorative elements, including a central rectangular panel flanked by matching turned spindle designs and four circular motifs, two on each side of the panel. The lower view shows the side of the chest, which measures 17 5/8 inches in length and 8 5/8 inches in height. The side profile includes a curved indentation on the upper edge and two turned spindle details aligned with those in the front view. Both views include horizontal layered moldings at the chest's base. The scale “ONE QUARTER INCH TO THE INCH” is noted at the bottom, along with the name “FRANCIS BORELLI.” The label “CHEST BOX” is written in large, outlined letters beneath the drawing.
title: Desk Box
